raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "an Ltd in England"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user's brother"
  role object "an Ltd in England"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to use"
    role subject "the user and the user's brother"
    role object "the same accountant"
    polarity affirmed
  end
